USB / wymienne poole są automatycznie blokowane dla bezpieczeństwa. Worker migracji później przenosi pliki do pooli pojemnościowych zgodnie z polityką tieringu.
admin.uploads.help_body:
Limity przesyłania

Tiering przesyłania
Nowe uploady trafiają najpierw do szybkiego wewnętrznego poola, a później migrują do storage pojemnościowego.

USB / wymienne poole są automatycznie blokowane dla bezpieczeństwa.

Interwał workera
Jak często worker migracji budzi się i skanuje landing storage.

Minimalny wiek landing
Plik musi pozostać w landing przynajmniej tak długo, zanim migracja będzie dozwolona.

Maks. plików na przebieg
Maksymalna liczba kwalifikujących się plików migrowanych podczas jednego skanu workera.

Przykład:
interval = 60
min age = 60
max/pass = 8

Worker budzi się co 60 sekund, migruje pliki starsze niż 60 sekund i przetwarza do 8 plików w każdym cyklu.

circlestack.profile.achReplay.account.no: You help keep this DNA-Nexus node alive. Steward badges are about responsibility: maintaining the server, supporting users, and keeping the space trustworthy.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.account.es: Your identity has started to build history. Time matters in DNA-Nexus because long-lived accounts are harder to fake than one-day identities.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.account.ol: This account has been around for a long time. Old Guard badges show continuity, patience, and a persistent identity inside your own network.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.account.le: A long-lived node becomes part of the story. Legacy Node marks an identity that has survived across time, updates, and changing communities.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.circlestac: Every network starts with one signal. This badge marks the moment your Circle Stack identity stopped being empty and started becoming part of the feed.
You keep contributing to the conversation. This badge is about showing up over time, not just making noise once.
Your Circle Stack presence has become steady. A broadcast node helps keep the community alive by adding regular signals to the network.
Anchor voices shape the memory of a circle. This badge is for long-term posting history and continued presence.
You have shared beyond your private circle. Public Voice means some of your posts help the wider DNA-Nexus network feel alive.
You enrich posts with media. Images, videos, and other files turn a feed from plain text into shared memory.
You take part in discussions instead of only posting alone. Replies are one of the strongest signs that a circle is becoming social.
You help surface other people’s posts. Reactions are small signals, but together they tell the community what matters.
Your posts invite response. This badge means your activity is not only visible — it is getting reactions from others.
You start conversations that others join. Thread Starter is about creating openings for discussion, not only broadcasting.
You are building trusted connections. Circle Builder is about turning isolated identities into a real social graph.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.shares.fir: You created your first share link. Sharing is one of the core NAS powers: letting someone access exactly what you choose, when you choose.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.shares.pac: You use your NAS as a distribution point. Packet Runner reflects repeated sharing without needing a centralized cloud service.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.shares.dis: Your server is becoming a serious distribution node. This badge marks long-term sharing activity from your own infrastructure.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.storage.da: You started growing your personal data vault. Small uploads become the seed of a long-term archive.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.storage.va: You are keeping meaningful data under your own control. Vault Keeper is about building a private archive instead of scattering files everywhere.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.storage.ke: Your storage is no longer just experimental. A large vault means your NAS is becoming part of your real digital life.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.storage.te: You are guarding a serious archive. Terabyte Guardian marks commitment to long-term self-hosted storage.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.dropzone.o: You opened a controlled upload path for others. Drop Zones let people send files to you without giving them full access to your NAS.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.dropzone.g: You show strong engagement by letting others send data into your storage through controlled gates. Keep managing those gates well.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.security.t: You paired a trusted device. Security badges are about strengthening identity and making access safer without losing convenience.
You saved your first page into Echo Stack. This is the start of your own web memory, kept on your NAS instead of disappearing into browser tabs.
You are preserving useful pieces of the web. Web Preserver is about turning passing links into a library you control.
Your Echo Stack is becoming a real knowledge vault. This badge means you are building memory, not just collecting bookmarks.
You are storing heavier web snapshots locally. Deep Archive is for users who want pages to remain available even when the original web changes.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.firs: You uploaded your first photo. This is where your NAS starts becoming a personal memory machine, not just a file bucket.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.memo: You are building a real photo history. Memory Keeper is about keeping your own visual memories under your own control.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.gall: Your photo library is becoming serious. Gallery Curator marks a NAS that is starting to feel like a private photo cloud.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.firs: You uploaded your first video. Reel Stack starts with one clip, but grows into a self-hosted video vault over time.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.vide: You are keeping videos on your own storage. Video Vault is about moving memories and media away from disposable cloud silos.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.cine: Your NAS is becoming a real video library. Cinema Keeper is for users who preserve larger moving memories and media collections.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.firs: You uploaded your first audio track. NeonWave starts when your NAS begins to carry sound, not only files.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.sign: You are building a music/audio collection. Signal DJ is about turning your NAS into a private listening base.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.media.soun: Your audio archive is becoming serious. Sound Vault marks a self-hosted library of tracks, recordings, or sound memories.
circlestack.profile.achReplay.federation: Your NAS has sent its first public Circle Stack signal into the wider DNA-Nexus network. This is the moment your node stops being only local.
Your NAS is carrying signals across the network. Signal Courier is about reliable participation, not just one successful test.
Your node heard another NAS. First Remote Signal means the federation is no longer theoretical — another origin reached your Circle Stack.
Conversation has crossed node boundaries. This badge marks real social activity between separate DNA-Nexus servers.
You added or discovered another NAS origin. Known origins are the first step toward a real web of personal servers.
You have helped connect this NAS with multiple origins. Bridge Builder is about making the wider DNA-Nexus network more discoverable.
